title: i18n project
description: The policy of a catalog folder. Which languages exist is the folders beside this file and what they say is the files in them; this holds what a folder cannot say.

source.description: The language the messages are written in. Its files are the complete set, they type the keys, and every fallback chain ends in it.

fallback.description: What an unfinished translation reads in before the source language.

locales.description: Policy per locale folder. A folder left out is a draft.

stage.description: draft: in the repository, offered to nobody. beta: offered, and reads in its fallback where it has no translation. stable: offered, and the check fails when a message is missing or out of date.

fallback.description: The language this one reads in where it has no translation, ahead of the project's fallback. A regional locale already falls back to its language.
